title: A license decision must use the app's own license rule, not a new one
rule: When code decides whether a face may be used for web, desktop or app (a shortlist, a filter, an export guard, an MCP tool), call the existing rule in crates/fm-core/src/license.rs (`license::web_use` for web; its precedence for other uses) instead of writing a new check. The user's declared license type comes first: a declared Desktop, Trial or Personal-only type is not OK for web even when the file names an open license, and a declared type allows only its own use. Test it with a face that has an open license and a conflicting declared type, and assert the new code agrees with `LicenseInfo.web_use`.
rationale: E27.4 (#174): pick_fonts_for_brief let a recognized open license beat the user's declared Desktop type, so it shortlisted for web a font the license panel and the web-OK filter call not OK for web.
